versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν, καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς τὴν πατρίδα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
controles.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
controles.livre: Jesus partiu-se dali, veio à sua terra, e seus discípulos o seguiram.

versos.grego: καὶ γενομένου σαββάτου ἤρξατο διδάσκειν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ· καὶ οἱ πολλοὶ ἀκούοντες ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες Πόθεν τούτῳ ταῦτα, καὶ τίς ἡ σοφία ἡ δοθεῖσα τούτῳ; καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις τοιαῦται διὰ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ γινόμεναι;

controles.web: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
controles.kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
controles.livre: E chegando o sábado, começou a ensinar na sinagoga; e muitos, quando o ouviram, espantavam-se, dizendo: De onde lhe vem estas coisas? E que sabedoria é esta que lhe foi dada? E tais maravilhas feitas por suas mãos?

versos.grego: οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ τέκτων, ὁ υἱὸς τῆς Μαρίας καὶ ἀδελφὸς Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωσῆτος καὶ Ἰούδα καὶ Σίμωνος; καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ αὐτοῦ ὧδε πρὸς ἡμᾶς; καὶ ἐσκανδαλίζοντο ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” They were offended at him.
controles.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
controles.livre: Não é este o carpinteiro, filho de Maria, e irmão de Tiago, de José, de Judas, e de Simão? E não estão aqui as suas irmãs conosco?E ofenderam-se nele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Οὐκ ἔστιν προφήτης ἄτιμος εἰ μὴ ἐν τῇ πατρίδι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
controles.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes dizia: Todo profeta tem honra,  menos em sua terra, entre os parentes, e em sua própria casa.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἐδύνατο ἐκεῖ ποιῆσαι οὐδεμίαν δύναμιν, εἰ μὴ ὀλίγοις ἀρρώστοις ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐθεράπευσεν.

controles.web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.
controles.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
controles.livre: Ele não pôde ali fazer milagre algum, a não ser somente para uns poucos enfermos, sobre os quais pôs as mãos e os curou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐθαύμασεν διὰ τὴν ἀπιστίαν αὐτῶν. Καὶ περιῆγεν τὰς κώμας κύκλῳ διδάσκων.

controles.web: He marveled because of their unbelief.   He went around the villages teaching.
controles.kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
controles.livre: E ficou admirado da incredulidade deles. Ele percorreu as aldeias do redor, ensinando.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσκαλεῖται τοὺς δώδεκα, καὶ ἤρξατο αὐτοὺς ἀποστέλλειν δύο δύο, καὶ ἐδίδου αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν ἀκαθάρτων,

controles.web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
controles.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
controles.livre: E chamou a si os doze, e começou a enviar de dois em dois; e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos.

versos.grego: καὶ παρήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδὲν αἴρωσιν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰ μὴ ῥάβδον μόνον, μὴ ἄρτον, μὴ πήραν, μὴ εἰς τὴν ζώνην χαλκόν,

controles.web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
controles.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
controles.livre: E mandou-lhes que não tomassem nada para o caminho, a não ser somente um bordão; nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro no cinto;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ὑποδεδεμένους σανδάλια, καὶ μὴ ἐνδύσησθε δύο χιτῶνας.

controles.web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
controles.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
controles.livre: mas que calçassem sandálias, e não se vestissem de duas túnicas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὅπου ἐὰν εἰσέλθητε εἰς οἰκίαν, ἐκεῖ μένετε ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθητε ἐκεῖθεν.

controles.web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
controles.livre: E dizia-lhes: Onde quer que entrardes em alguma casa, ficai ali até que dali saiais.

versos.grego: καὶ ὃς ἂν τόπος μὴ δέξηται ὑμᾶς μηδὲ ἀκούσωσιν ὑμῶν, ἐκπορευόμενοι ἐκεῖθεν ἐκτινάξατε τὸν χοῦν τὸν ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
controles.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
controles.livre: E todos os que não vos receberem, nem vos ouvirem, quando sairdes dali, sacudi o pó que estiver debaixo de vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles..

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν ἵνα μετανοῶσιν,

controles.web: They went out and preached that people should repent.
controles.kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
controles.livre: Eles, então, se foram, e pregaram que as pessoas se arrependessem.

versos.grego: καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλλον, καὶ ἤλειφον ἐλαίῳ πολλοὺς ἀρρώστους καὶ ἐθεράπευον.

controles.web: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.
controles.kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
controles.livre: Eles expulsaram muitos demônios, e a muitos enfermos ungiram com azeite, e os curaram.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης, φανερὸν γὰρ ἐγένετο τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάνης ὁ Βαπτίζων ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ διὰ τοῦτο ἐνεργοῦσιν αἱ δυνάμεις ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
controles.kjv: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
controles.livre: O rei Herodes ouviu falar disso (porque o nome de Jesus já era notório). E diziam: João Batista ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso estas maravilhas operam nele.

versos.grego: ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἡλείας ἐστίν· ἄλλοι δὲ ἔλεγον ὅτι προφήτης ὡς εἷς τῶν προφητῶν.

controles.web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
controles.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
controles.livre: Outros diziam: É Elias; e outros diziam: É profeta, como algum dos profetas.

versos.grego: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἔλεγεν Ὃν ἐγὼ ἀπεκεφάλισα Ἰωάνην, οὗτος ἠγέρθη.

controles.web: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
controles.kjv: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
controles.livre: Quando, porém, Herodes ouviu falar disso, falou: Ele é João, de quem cortei a cabeça. Ele ressuscitou .

versos.grego: Αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἀποστείλας ἐκράτησεν τὸν Ἰωάνην καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν ἐν φυλακῇ διὰ Ἡρῳδιάδα τὴν γυναῖκα Φιλίππου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι αὐτὴν ἐγάμησεν·

controles.web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
controles.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
controles.livre: Pois o próprio Herodes havia mandado prender João, e acorrentá-lo na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe, porque havia se casado com ela.

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὁ Ἰωάνης τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ ὅτι Οὐκ ἔξεστίν σοι ἔχειν τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου.

controles.web: For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
controles.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
controles.livre: Pois João dizia a Herodes: Não te é lícito possuir a mulher do teu irmão.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ Ἡρῳδιὰς ἐνεῖχεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἤθελεν αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο·

controles.web: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
controles.kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
controles.livre: Assim Herodias o odiava, e queria matá-lo, mas não podia,

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ἐφοβεῖτο τὸν Ἰωάνην, εἰδὼς αὐτὸν ἄνδρα δίκαιον καὶ ἅγιον, καὶ συνετήρει αὐτόν, καὶ ἀκούσας αὐτοῦ πολλὰ ἠπόρει, καὶ ἡδέως αὐτοῦ ἤκουεν.

controles.web: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
controles.kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
controles.livre: pois Herodes temia João, sabendo que era um homem justo e santo, e o estimava. E quando o ouvia, ficava muito perplexo, o ouvia de boa vontade.

versos.grego: Καὶ γενομένης ἡμέρας εὐκαίρου ὅτε Ἡρῴδης τοῖς γενεσίοις αὐτοῦ δεῖπνον ἐποίησεν τοῖς μεγιστᾶσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῖς χιλιάρχοις καὶ τοῖς πρώτοις τῆς Γαλιλαίας,

controles.web: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
controles.kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
controles.livre: Mas veio um dia oportuno, em que Herodes, no dia do seu aniversário, dava uma ceia aos grandes de sua corte, aos comandantes militares, e aos principais da Galileia.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσελθούσης τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτῆς τῆς Ἡρῳδιάδος καὶ ὀρχησαμένης, ἤρεσεν τῷ Ἡρῴδῃ καὶ τοῖς συνανακειμένοις. ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς εἶπεν τῷ κορασίῳ Αἴτησόν με ὃ ἐὰν θέλῃς, καὶ δώσω σοι·

controles.web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
controles.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
controles.livre: Então a filha dessa Herodias entrou dançando, e agradou a Herodes e aos que estavam sentados com ele. O rei disse à garota: Pede-me quanto quiseres, que eu darei a ti.

versos.grego: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῇ Ὅτι ἐάν με αἰτήσῃς δώσω σοι ἕως ἡμίσους τῆς βασιλείας μου.

controles.web: He swore to her, “Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
controles.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
controles.livre: E jurou a ela: Tudo o que me pedirdes te darei, até a metade do meu reino.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξελθοῦσα εἶπεν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς Τί αἰτήσωμαι; ἡ δὲ εἶπεν Τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτίζοντος.

controles.web: She went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?”   She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
controles.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
controles.livre: Então ela saiu, e perguntou à sua mãe: Que pedirei? E ela respondeu: A cabeça de João Batista.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα εὐθὺς μετὰ σπουδῆς πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ᾐτήσατο λέγουσα Θέλω ἵνα ἐξαυτῆς δῷς μοι ἐπὶ πίνακι τὴν κεφαλὴν Ἰωάνου τοῦ Βαπτιστοῦ.

controles.web: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
controles.kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
controles.livre: E entrando ela logo apressadamente ao rei, pediu, dizendo: Quero que imediatamente me dês num prato a cabeça de João Batista.

versos.grego: καὶ περίλυπος γενόμενος ὁ βασιλεὺς διὰ τοὺς ὅρκους καὶ τοὺς ἀνακειμένους οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἀθετῆσαι αὐτήν.

controles.web: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
controles.kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
controles.livre: E o rei entristeceu-se muito; mas , por causa dos juramentos, e dos que estavam juntamente à mesa, não quis recusar a ela.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀποστείλας ὁ βασιλεὺς σπεκουλάτορα ἐπέταξεν ἐνέγκαι τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John’s head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
controles.kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
controles.livre: Então logo o rei enviou o executor com a ordem de trazer ali sua cabeça. Ele, foi, e o decapitou na prisão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἀπεκεφάλισεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ, καὶ ἤνεγκεν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πίνακι καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν τῷ κορασίῳ, καὶ τὸ κοράσιον ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
controles.kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
controles.livre: Em seguida, trouxe a sua cabeça num prato, e o deu à garota; e a garota a deu à sua mãe.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἦλθαν καὶ ἦραν τὸ πτῶμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθηκαν αὐτὸ ἐν μνημείῳ.

controles.web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
controles.kjv: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
controles.livre: Quando os discípulos dele ouviram isso, vieram, pegaram o seu cadáver, e o puseram num sepulcro.

versos.grego: Καὶ συνάγονται οἱ ἀπόστολοι πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησαν καὶ ὅσα ἐδίδαξαν.

controles.web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
controles.kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
controles.livre: Os apóstolos juntaram-se de volta a Jesus, e contaram-lhe tudo, tanto o que haviam feito, como o que haviam ensinado.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Δεῦτε ὑμεῖς αὐτοὶ κατ’ ἰδίαν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον καὶ ἀναπαύσασθε ὀλίγον. ἦσαν γὰρ οἱ ἐρχόμενοι καὶ οἱ ὑπάγοντες πολλοί, καὶ οὐδὲ φαγεῖν εὐκαίρουν.

controles.web: He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Vinde vós à parte a um lugar deserto, e descansai um pouco; pois havia muitos que iam e vinham, e não tinham tempo para comer.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπῆλθον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κατ’ ἰδίαν.

controles.web: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
controles.kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
controles.livre: E foram-se num barco a um lugar deserto à parte.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶδον αὐτοὺς ὑπάγοντας καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν πολλοί, καὶ πεζῇ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν πόλεων συνέδραμον ἐκεῖ καὶ προῆλθον αὐτούς.

controles.web: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
controles.kjv: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
controles.livre: Mas os viram ir, e muitos o reconheceram. Então correram para lá a pé de todas as cidades, chegaram antes deles.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν εἶδεν πολὺν ὄχλον, καὶ ἐσπλαγχνίσθη ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς ὅτι ἦσαν ὡς πρόβατα μὴ ἔχοντα ποιμένα, καὶ ἤρξατο διδάσκειν αὐτοὺς πολλά.

controles.web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.
controles.kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
controles.livre: Quando  Jesus  saiu do barco , viu uma grande multidão, e teve compaixão deles porque eram como ovelhas que não têm pastor. Assim, começou a lhes ensinar muitas coisas.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἤδη ὥρας πολλῆς γενομένης προσελθόντες αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἔρημός ἐστιν ὁ τόπος, καὶ ἤδη ὥρα πολλή·

controles.web: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
controles.kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
controles.livre: E quando já era tarde, os seus discípulos vieram a ele, e disseram: O lugar é deserto, e a hora já é tarde.

versos.grego: ἀπόλυσον αὐτούς, ἵνα ἀπελθόντες εἰς τοὺς κύκλῳ ἀγροὺς καὶ κώμας ἀγοράσωσιν ἑαυτοῖς τί φάγωσιν.

controles.web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
controles.kjv: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
controles.livre: Despede-os, para eles irem aos campos e aldeias circunvizinhos, e comprarem comida.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Δότε αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς φαγεῖν. καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Ἀπελθόντες ἀγοράσωμεν δηναρίων διακοσίων ἄρτους, καὶ δώσομεν αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν;

controles.web: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.”   They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?”
controles.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
controles.livre: Mas ele respondeu: Dai-lhes vós mesmos de comer. E eles lhe responderam: Iremos, e compraremos duzentos denários de pão, para lhes darmos de comer?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ λέγει αὐτοῖς Πόσους ἔχετε ἄρτους; ὑπάγετε ἴδετε. καὶ γνόντες λέγουσιν Πέντε, καὶ δύο ἰχθύας.

controles.web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.”   When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
controles.kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Quantos pães tendes? Ide ver. Quando souberam, disseram: Cinco, e dois peixes.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέταξεν αὐτοῖς ἀνακλιθῆναι πάντας συμπόσια συμπόσια ἐπὶ τῷ χλωρῷ χόρτῳ.

controles.web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
controles.kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
controles.livre: E mandou-lhes que fizessem sentar a todos em grupos sobre a grama verde.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνέπεσαν πρασιαὶ πρασιαὶ κατὰ ἑκατὸν καὶ κατὰ πεντήκοντα.

controles.web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
controles.kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
controles.livre: E sentaram-se repartidos de cem em cem, e de cinquenta em cinquenta.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβὼν τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν καὶ κατέκλασεν τοὺς ἄρτους καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἵνα παρατιθῶσιν αὐτοῖς, καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας ἐμέρισεν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
controles.kjv: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
controles.livre: Ele tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, abençoou, e partiu os pães, e os deu aos discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E os dois peixes repartiu com todos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔφαγον πάντες καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν·

controles.web: They all ate, and were filled.
controles.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled.
controles.livre: Todos comeram e se saciaram.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦραν κλάσματα δώδεκα κοφίνων πληρώματα καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰχθύων.

controles.web: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
controles.kjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
controles.livre: E dos pedaços de pão e dos peixes levantaram doze cestos cheios.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ φαγόντες τοὺς ἄρτους πεντακισχίλιοι ἄνδρες.

controles.web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
controles.kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
controles.livre: Os que comeram os pães eram cinco mil homens.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἠνάγκασεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἐμβῆναι εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ προάγειν εἰς τὸ πέραν πρὸς Βηθσαϊδάν, ἕως αὐτὸς ἀπολύει τὸν ὄχλον.

controles.web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
controles.kjv: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
controles.livre: Logo depois, ordenou seus discípulos a subirem no barco, e ir adiante para o outro lado, em Betsaida, enquanto ele despedia a multidão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποταξάμενος αὐτοῖς ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι.

controles.web: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
controles.kjv: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
controles.livre: E, depois de os despedir, foi ao monte para orar.

versos.grego: καὶ ὀψίας γενομένης ἦν τὸ πλοῖον ἐν μέσῳ τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ αὐτὸς μόνος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: When evening had come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
controles.kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
controles.livre: Ao anoitecer, o barco estava no meio do mar, e Jesus sozinho em terra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτοὺς βασανιζομένους ἐν τῷ ἐλαύνειν, ἦν γὰρ ὁ ἄνεμος ἐναντίος αὐτοῖς, περὶ τετάρτην φυλακὴν τῆς νυκτὸς ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτοὺς περιπατῶν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης· καὶ ἤθελεν παρελθεῖν αὐτούς.

controles.web: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea,  and he would have passed by them,
controles.kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
controles.livre: E viu que se cansavam muito remando, porque o vento lhes era contrário. Então, perto da quarta vigília da noite, veio a eles andando sobre o mar, e queria passar por eles.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης περιπατοῦντα ἔδοξαν ὅτι φάντασμά ἐστιν, καὶ ἀνέκραξαν·

controles.web: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
controles.kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
controles.livre: Mas quando eles o viram andando sobre o mar, pensaram que era uma fantasma, e gritaram,

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ αὐτὸν εἶδαν καὶ ἐταράχθησαν. ὁ δὲ εὐθὺς ἐλάλησεν μετ’ αὐτῶν, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Θαρσεῖτε, ἐγώ εἰμι, μὴ φοβεῖσθε.

controles.web: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
controles.kjv: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
controles.livre: pois todos o viam, e ficaram perturbados. Então logo falou com eles, dizendo: Tende coragem! Sou eu, não tenhais medo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνέβη πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ πλοῖον, καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος· καὶ λίαν ἐκ περισσοῦ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἐξίσταντο·

controles.web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
controles.kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
controles.livre: E subiu a eles no barco, e o vento se aquietou. Eles ficaram muito espantados entre si,

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ συνῆκαν ἐπὶ τοῖς ἄρτοις, ἀλλ’ ἦν αὐτῶν ἡ καρδία πεπωρωμένη.

controles.web: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
controles.kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
controles.livre: pois não haviam entendido o que tinha acontecido com os pães, em vez disso o coração deles estava endurecido.

versos.grego: Καὶ διαπεράσαντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἦλθον εἰς Γεννησαρὲτ καὶ προσωρμίσθησαν.

controles.web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
controles.kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
controles.livre: Eles terminaram de atravessar o mar, chegaram à terra de Genesaré, e ali aportaram.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξελθόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ πλοίου εὐθὺς ἐπιγνόντες αὐτὸν

controles.web: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
controles.kjv: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
controles.livre: Quando eles saíram do barco, logo as pessoas o reconheceram.

versos.grego: περιέδραμον ὅλην τὴν χώραν ἐκείνην καὶ ἤρξαντο ἐπὶ τοῖς κραβάττοις τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας περιφέρειν, ὅπου ἤκουον ὅτι ἐστίν.

controles.web: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.
controles.kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
controles.livre: Então gente de toda a região em redor veio correndo, e começaram a trazer em camas os doentes, aonde quer que ouviam que ele estava.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅπου ἂν εἰσεπορεύετο εἰς κώμας ἢ εἰς πόλεις ἢ εἰς ἀγροὺς, ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς ἐτίθεσαν τοὺς ἀσθενοῦντας, καὶ παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν ἵνα κἂν τοῦ κρασπέδου τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ ἅψωνται· καὶ ὅσοι ἂν ἥψαντο αὐτοῦ ἐσῴζοντο.

controles.web: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might touch just the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
controles.kjv: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
controles.livre: E aonde quer que ele entrava, em povoados, cidades, ou aldeias, colocavam os enfermos nas praças, e rogavam-lhe que ao menos tocassem a borda de sua roupa; e todos os que o tocavam ficavam sarados.
